* **Sharp Decliners:** Aerospace & Defense fell 37 spots to rank 110 (momentum 0.28), while Aluminum and Utilities - Renewable both dropped 36 spots, landing at ranks 85 and 103 respectively.
* **Severe Laggards:** Bottom-tier momentum is concentrated in Utilities - Independent Power Producers (momentum 0.063), Advertising Agencies (momentum 0.074), and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.099).

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** High-momentum groups are starting to slip in rank, led by Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.60, rank -8) and Capital Markets (momentum 0.64, rank -6).
* **Emerging Defensives:** Household & Personal Products jumped 15 spots despite low momentum (0.47), while Paper & Paper Products and Utilities - Regulated Water both climbed 9 spots with sub-0.50 momentum scores.
